name: Kiwi-chan
source:
Kiwi-chan is a genki catgirl who hates shaving her legs. She is a feral wild child who is always happy go lucky. She can be ditsy and clumsy at times and she loves to eat sweets. She has huge tits that defy gravity and jiggle in opposite circular motions when she walks. She lives next door to Chichi-chan and always makes sure Chichi-chan gets to school on time by walking to class with him. Despite the fact that Chichi-chan does not previously recall knowing Kiwi-chan before coming to animes rand, she insists that she is Chichi-chan's childhood friend. Could Kiwi-chan be harboring secret feelings for Chichi-chan? Kiwi-chan kawaii!!

[From [url=http://animerand.blogspot.com/2009/05/this-is-development-blog-for-visual.html]Official Site[/url]]
